name: apple-music
description: Apple Music metadata and lyrics provider for Mornye with guarded track matching, bounded caching, resilient requests, and complete release metadata.

settings.label: Storefront / Region
settings.description: Country used for Home recommendations, search, and catalog availability. No VPN is required.

settings.label: Media User Token
settings.description: Required for lyrics. Get it from browser console on music.apple.com: MusicKit.getInstance().musicUserToken. Needs an active Apple Music subscription.

settings.label: Lyrics Translation Language
settings.description: Language code for translated lyrics (e.g. en, zh-Hans, ja, ko, id). Leave empty to disable. Uses Apple Music's built-in translations.

settings.label: Lyrics Pronunciation Language
settings.description: Language code for romanized pronunciation (e.g. ja-Latn for romaji, ko-Latn for Korean). Leave empty to disable.
